channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Carmelo Anthony | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Carmelo Anthony from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Josh Hart on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Josh Hart:

“No one knows the understand besides y'all that wear the jersey, no one understands the weight that that jersey has sometimes. And, you know, we kind of talk around it and dance around it, but New York is a special place, but there's a lot of pressure when you put that jersey on. So we want to thank you and celebrate you (Carmelo Anthony) a little bit, man, for laying the foundation, but also, you know, talking to us during it.”

Josh Hart on Carmelo Anthony, Jun 22, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jusuf Nurkic on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard
item.description:
Jusuf Nurkic:

“We had that great mindset, starting with Damian Lillard, who was a real leader. He led by example. I don’t know how to explain it in the best way, but whatever he wanted others to do, that’s how it was. He could be loud, but he always led by example, whether in practice or on the plane — the guy was never late. We never had any problems in the locker room. Whoever came in through trades had to fit into that system. Until Carmelo (laughs). He kind of stepped outside the system because he was always late, he missed almost every meeting. The coach was traumatized by that and didn’t want anyone to be late, and he didn’t have many rules, but he stuck to that one.”

Jusuf Nurkic on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, Jun 1, 2026. Source: Basketball Sphere.

item.title: Austin Rivers on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Kevin Durant, Carmelo Anthony, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, James Harden
item.description:
Fullcourtpass: Austin Rivers on scoring in the NBA

“LeBron James doesn’t have half the offensive bag that Kevin [Durant]has…I would say Kevin Durant, Carmelo Anthony, James Harden, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, and Allen Iverson are the best scorers I’ve ever seen”

Austin Rivers on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Kevin Durant, Carmelo Anthony, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, James Harden, Aug 13, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Pat Riley on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Pat Riley on Carmelo Anthony:

“I think from the standpoint of what they call small forwards, he wasn’t just that. He can play small forward, sure. He can play power forward. Back then, we were more positional. He could play the two-guard. Today, he’d be playing 5.That’s just the way the game has grown. But he deserves it. I hope he makes it.”

Pat Riley on Carmelo Anthony, Feb 14, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Retired former Knicks All-Star Carmelo Anthony huddled with center Karl-Anthony Towns in the locker room for several minutes after Friday’s game.

“I think you could find out in interviews and stuff,I’m a huge Carmelo Anthony fan,”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Carmelo Anthony, Nov 10, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Bogdan Bogdanovic on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Bogdan Bogdanovic on Carmelo Anthony celebration:

“I've been doing that for a long time. I know some people think it is a provocation.. But it is just media. He (Carmelo) is a legend.”

Bogdan Bogdanovic on Carmelo Anthony, Aug 10, 2024. Source: reddit.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
“Melo [Anthony] was actually still on theroster. I really took the job thinking that I was going to be coaching him. You know with Dame [Lillard] and CJ [McCollum], Nurk [Nurkic]. So it was perfect for me, I'm thinking okay boom, a few moves here and there, I'm coming to like try to elevate things and then very quickly it changed.”

Chauncey Billups on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Jusuf Nurkic, Jul 23, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Carmelo Anthony, Luol Deng
item.description:
“I didn't know how good he would become. I think his first year was the lockout year; he was playing behind Luol Deng, really the first opportunity he had to play was here at the Garden. It was midway [through the season], Luol was out, he had to guard Melo [Carmelo Anthony]. And he came in -- I was talking to the coaches before the game, I said, 'Are we really playing him? First game [here]?' And he was great. And that told me a lot about him right there. And then each year he just got better and better.”

Tom Thibodeau on Carmelo Anthony, Luol Deng, May 6, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: John Wall on Carmelo Anthony, Allen Iverson
item.description:
“I think about my favorite player, Allen Iverson. They asked him to come off the bench and do those things in different places, and there’s no way AI shouldn’t have still been in the league, you know what I mean? It’s just that pride didn’t let him go. You look at [Carmelo Anthony]. He accepted his pride. He was back with the Lakers last year. I’m not trying to be one of those guys on the outside looking in. I’m trying to keep it as cool as I can and stay in this position.”

John Wall on Carmelo Anthony, Allen Iverson, Dec 10, 2022. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: John Wall on Carmelo Anthony, Dwight Howard, Kemba Walker
item.description:
“I feel like I was on the edge of kinda getting pushed out myself. If I wasn’t a true professional last year and the Clippers didn’t give me a chance, I don’t know if I’d probably been here right now. “We have so many great guys that can be like (Carmelo Anthony), Dwight [Howard], … even Kemba Walker. … You need veteran guys to help these young teams out as much as possible.”

John Wall on Carmelo Anthony, Dwight Howard, Kemba Walker, Nov 19, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Clyde Drexler on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Robinson: Nets, Knicks NBA free agent target Carmelo Anthony has a supporter in Hall of Famer & @thebig3 commissionerClyde Drexler:

“Carmelo is a proven commodity, so his real value is what he can do to help that team in the playoffs and I can’t wait.”

Clyde Drexler on Carmelo Anthony, Aug 30, 2022. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Max Christie on LeBron James, Carmelo Anthony, Russell Westbrook, Anthony Davis
item.description:
Max Christie on joining LA:

“It's amazing. It's surreal. LeBron James, Anthony Davis, Russell Westbrook, Carmelo Anthony -- the list goes on. A bunch of great names, a bunch of great players on the Lakers team. I think I can learn a lot and get a lot better in that organization.”

Max Christie on LeBron James, Carmelo Anthony, Russell Westbrook, Anthony Davis, Jun 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
“All I have to say is this: I was there to give Carmelo Anthony the NBA Social Justice Champion Award. I've been talking to the press since high school, that's 60 years of making statements. And I haven't always gotten it right. And Sunday was one of those nights,”

Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on Carmelo Anthony, Apr 5, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Durant on passing Carmelo:

“Its still weird for me to do stuff like this because I play a team sport& I try my hardest to make it about the group. But it is special to do something like that. Scoring is something I’ve worked on my whole career and expanded my whole career.”

Kevin Durant on Carmelo Anthony, Jul 31, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Carmelo:

“He loves the game. He’s having a great year doing a great job. He has been wonderful throughout his career. Anything that’s good that happens for him, I’m very excited about it, because he has done a lot.”

Gregg Popovich on Carmelo Anthony, May 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, Terry Stotts
item.description:
“We had some elite grapes there. One night, Dame [Damian Lillard], Melo [Carmelo Anthony], Terry [Stotts, the Blazers’ head coach] and our trainer Geoff Clark had some heavy hitters over dinner, including a 2014 Screaming Eagle.”

CJ McCollum on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, Terry Stotts, Apr 24, 2021. Source: Robb Report.

item.title: Michael Malone on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Robert Covington, Rodney Hood, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins
item.description:
Michael Malone on the Blazers, Denver's opponent tomorrow:

“I think Portland's really good. Last year they were decimated by injuries. I think Terry does a really good job as their coach. One of the best backcourts in the NBA with CJ McCollum and Damian Lillard, Carmelo Anthony, Jusuf Nurkic. They've got Rodney Hood back. Zach Collins back. They get Robert Covington. They're a good basketball team. I think they're going to have a much better season in the regular season than they had last year because they're going to be healthy.”

Michael Malone on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Robert Covington, Rodney Hood, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins, Dec 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
“I think when you have Carmelo Anthony out there, regardless of the age, or whatever people say, it’s a respect factor, people respect you different,”

Damian Lillard on Carmelo Anthony, Dec 7, 2020. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Sean Highkin:CJ McCollum on Carmelo Anthony:

“First and foremost, he's a great person. He brings great storytelling, good charisma. Does a lot for the locker room.”

CJ McCollum on Carmelo Anthony, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Damian Lillard on Carmelo Anthony re-signing:

“He wanted to come back, I wanted him to come back, Terry wanted him to come back, all our teammates wanted him to come back. ... It's a respect factor. That's a key for us, having that respect.”

Damian Lillard on Carmelo Anthony, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Neil Olshey on re-signing Carmelo Anthony:

“Probably the most important thing for us, honestly. What he does for our spirit.”

Neil Olshey on Carmelo Anthony, Nov 23, 2020. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Neil Olshey on Carmelo Anthony:

“We've kind of become the custodians of his legacy. He's going to be a first-ballot Hall of Famer ... the longer he stays in Portland, the more we're associated with his legacy.”

Neil Olshey on Carmelo Anthony, Nov 23, 2020. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: LeBron James on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
LeBron on going up against Carmelo Anthony:

“It's always fun and exciting to be on the same floor as one of your brothers.”

LeBron James on Carmelo Anthony, Aug 17, 2020. Source: Twitter @LakersNation.

item.title: LeBron James on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
LeBron James on the Carmelo Anthony banana boat incident in the Bahamas:

“We all talked about it and he told me he felt like I saved his life. I don't really know what to say, to be honest. I'm just happy he's still here.”

LeBron James on Carmelo Anthony, Aug 17, 2020. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Damian Lillard on Carmelo Anthony:

“He should have been here three years ago. We get on his case about that all the time. I feel like we could have been in the Finals last year if we had him.”

Damian Lillard on Carmelo Anthony, Aug 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Rockets’ Russell Westbrook on Blazers’ Carmelo Anthony:

“Melo is a Hall of Famer, man. He’s an unbelievable teammate. It’s always good to see him do well, play well. He belongs in this league. He’s shown that time in and time out.”

Russell Westbrook on Carmelo Anthony, Aug 5, 2020. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Larry Brown on Darko Milicic, Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
After Milicic struggled to complete two workouts he had with the Pistons,Brown was eager to get Anthony into town so that they could evaluate his ability to guard and how he moved his feet during a workout.

“Let’s bring Carmelo in; we brought Milicic in and you told me, guys, you’re gonna draft Carmelo anyway,”

Larry Brown on Darko Milicic, Carmelo Anthony, May 7, 2020. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Butler won gold with Team USA in the 2016 Olympics in Rio de Janeiro.

“I told [Carmelo Anthony] that if he plays [in the Olympics], I play,”

Jimmy Butler on Carmelo Anthony, May 4, 2020. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Ben Wallace on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Ben Wallace on the Pistons drafting Darko Millicic over Carmelo Anthony:

“If we would’ve drafted Carmelo, I honestly don’t think we would have ever won a championship. Melo wanted to play right away. It would have had the potential to disrupt the team chemistry.”

Ben Wallace on Carmelo Anthony, Apr 7, 2020. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Carmelo Anthony
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Gregg Popovich on @Carmelo Anthony being back in the NBA:

“It’s what he loves to do. He has a great, outsized personality. Guys enjoy him. And he can still get things done on the court. Someone like him, who has been a fabric of the league so long, it’s great to see him around.”

Gregg Popovich on Carmelo Anthony, Feb 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.
